objective: Rebuild Consensus on point-in-time JPX membership and point-in-time nominal absolute-price eligibility, then separate data-contract repair from canonical-target repair.

mandatory_inputs.pit_membership_receipt: accepted Consensus PIT Universe Replay artifact
mandatory_inputs.daily_history: run80 frozen daily for survivor symbols plus coverage-audited historical daily for restored delisted symbols
mandatory_inputs.intraday_history: causal Yahoo raw clock-bin source with frozen coverage receipt

point_in_time_candidate_contract.membership: symbol must be a JPX domestic common stock member as of the signal date
point_in_time_candidate_contract.prior_close: point-in-time nominal prior completed-day close <= JPY 1000
point_in_time_candidate_contract.prior_volume: historical prior completed-day volume >= 10000 shares; no split-factor transformation unless a separate source-validation receipt proves one is required
point_in_time_candidate_contract.absolute_feature: log_price must use point-in-time nominal current-bin price
point_in_time_candidate_contract.relative_features: keep causal split-normalized price series for ratio/return/technical features so corporate actions do not create artificial jumps
point_in_time_candidate_contract.cross_sectional: recompute all ranks, market medians, breadth and candidate count from the clean PIT-eligible date/session universe

model_frozen_from_v11.features: same feature family as v11, with locally reconstructed stable_score/technical_bits6 unchanged for experiment comparability

prequential_contract.initial_history: 2024-10-01..2024-12-31 where clean PIT data coverage permits
prequential_contract.purge: training label exit must be strictly before block start

V47A.labels: same legacy signal-bin-close -> D+5 official close labels as V43
V47A.purpose: Isolate effect of PIT membership/eligibility/absolute-price repair without also changing the learning target.
restrictions: Do not choose between V47A and V47B based on higher mean.

V47B.labels: next official XTKS-session open after signal date -> D+5 official close
restrictions: No architecture/hyperparameter/threshold tuning on 2025 or 2026 outcomes.

atr_policy.old_2_864_cap: diagnostic only; not applied to V47A/B primary result
atr_policy.clean_reestimation: may only be computed outcome-free from full clean eligible date/session contexts after V47 clean data materialization

operational_stress_after_primary.strict_same_symbol_hold: 5 official trading sessions, one position per symbol
operational_stress_after_primary.replacement: NOT part of primary V47B; a later separately preregistered Top-K replacement test only if base V47B demonstrates edge

coverage_fail_closed.rule: No promotion claim if missing-data coverage can materially select the survivor subset. Coverage threshold/policy cannot be chosen from returns.

prohibited: Do not delete contaminated V43/V44 rows after scoring and call the remainder clean.
Do not reuse the old 2.864 ATR cap as a promotion gate without clean outcome-free re-estimation.
Do not tune thresholds or models on 2026.
Do not compare V47A vs V47B and pick whichever historical mean is higher.
